reminder_stages.name: Courteous heads-up
reminder_stages.tone: Light, friendly heads-up that a bill is coming due. No pressure at all.

reminder_stages.name: Polite reminder
reminder_stages.tone: Polite and understanding. Assume it was an oversight.

reminder_stages.name: Firm reminder
reminder_stages.tone: Clear and firm but respectful. Ask the customer to pay or contact support.

reminder_stages.name: Final reminder
reminder_stages.tone: Serious and direct, still courteous. State this is a final reminder and invite them to contact support for help.

footers.offer: This offer is personal to you and cannot be transferred or exchanged for cash. {terms} You are receiving this email because you opted in to communications from {company}. To stop receiving these emails, reply STOP or update your preferences in your account settings.
footers.reminder: If you have already paid, please ignore this message. If you think this bill is incorrect, you can raise a dispute or get help any time by replying to this email or writing to {support_email}.
footers.no_offer: You are receiving this email because you opted in to communications from {company}. To stop receiving these emails, reply STOP or update your preferences in your account settings.
